items.t: COP31 climate talks in Turkey end without a deal
items.d: The UN summit ran past its deadline into Sunday night but countries could not agree, renewing calls to scrap the consensus rule that lets any nation block an outcome.

items.t: Russia threatens 'painful consequences' over Ukrainian sea drone strikes
items.d: Kyiv says it sank a Russian corvette in Benghazi, Libya, and a Baltic cargo ship was set ablaze. The Kremlin calls the widening attacks a dangerous trend.

items.t: Huang's Nvidia return sparks global stock rally
items.d: Nvidia jumped 31.5% and the Nasdaq 6.5% on Monday. Asia followed on Tuesday: Taiwan's Taiex rose over 9%, Seoul's Kospi 6.5% and Tokyo's Nikkei 3.9%.

items.t: NATO believes Russia ready to launch nuclear-armed satellite
items.d: German media say allied spy agencies think Moscow could put the weapon in orbit soon, which would breach the treaty banning nuclear arms in space.

items.t: Drought pushes millions of Afghans deeper into crisis
items.d: Failed rains and shrinking foreign aid are leaving families short of food and water as winter arrives.

items.t: Beijing praises turnout in Hong Kong Election Committee vote
items.d: Thousands voted in the poll for the body that picks Hong Kong's leader; Beijing hailed what it called healthy competition.

items.t: Nvidia adds nearly $1tn in value in a single day
items.d: It was the chipmaker's best day in over two decades, recovering most of the slump that followed Huang's exit; SEC and DOJ probes continue.

items.t: Deloitte sees Hong Kong back in budget surplus
items.d: The firm forecasts a HK$20.8bn surplus for 2026/27, with fiscal reserves rising to about HK$686bn by March 2027.

items.t: Dell and HPE seek AI server price rises of up to 45%
items.d: Customers were asked to pay more even after deals were signed, as memory and chip costs soar from AI demand.

items.t: Nvidia brings Jensen Huang back as CEO after 11 days
items.d: The board said it was satisfied after talks with him and US officials found no security risk. He quit over affairs, one with a suspected Chinese spy.

items.t: Apple builds an autonomous AI agent for the Mac
items.d: The agent would carry out tasks across apps on its own, putting Apple in direct competition with OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.t: Meta rethinks its 2030 net-zero goal as AI emissions soar
items.d: Its emissions rose about 40% in a year to over 21.7m tonnes, driven by power-hungry AI data centres.

items.t: Mathematician says Claude helped prove the Riemann hypothesis
items.d: Anthropic's Levent Alpoge published a machine-checkable proof; experts are still verifying that it proves the 167-year-old problem as intended.

items.t: Chrome patches six critical flaws, two found with AI help
items.d: Google urges users to update now; it shows AI tools are increasingly finding serious security bugs.

items.t: Supply-chain hack served malicious code on big news sites
items.d: Attackers compromised Optimizely software used by sites including CNN, BBC and Zoom, briefly pushing harmful scripts to visitors.

items.t: US loses measles elimination status after 25 years
items.d: The Pan American Health Organization confirmed it after more than 5,400 US cases this year, as surveys show vaccine myths persist.

items.t: Newly found viruses reveal an evolutionary missing link
items.d: Using AI protein tools, scientists found tiny viruses suggesting viruses and cell structures called encapsulins evolved from each other repeatedly.

items.t: Cargo ship named after Jim Lovell set for ISS launch
items.d: Northrop Grumman's Cygnus XL will carry about 5 tonnes of supplies on a SpaceX Falcon 9, no earlier than 29 November.

items.t: Burnham defends 'landmark' EU deal to MPs
items.d: The prime minister said the agreement offers change over a broken status quo, but rejoining the EU without a referendum would be unthinkable.

items.t: Snow warning as cold, unsettled weather continues
items.d: The Met Office has warnings in force with snow and ice risks, so check travel before setting off.

items.t: COP31氣候峰會無協議告終
items.d: 在土耳其舉行的聯合國氣候大會延至周日深夜仍未能達成共識，各國再度要求改革容許任何一國否決結果的「協商一致」規則。

items.t: 俄警告烏克蘭海上無人機襲擊將招「痛苦後果」
items.d: 基輔稱在利比亞班加西擊沉一艘俄羅斯輕型護衛艦，波羅的海一艘貨輪亦起火。克里姆林宮指襲擊擴大是危險趨勢。

items.t: 黃仁勳重返Nvidia 環球股市急升
items.d: Nvidia周一股價急升31.5%，納指升6.5%。亞洲股市周二跟隨：台灣加權指數升逾9%，韓國綜指升6.5%，日經指數升3.9%。

items.t: 北約相信俄羅斯準備發射核武衛星
items.d: 德國傳媒報道，盟國情報機構認為莫斯科或於短期內把核武送上軌道，將違反禁止太空核武的條約。

items.t: 旱災令數以百萬計阿富汗人陷更深危機
items.d: 雨水不足加上外國援助減少，入冬之際大批家庭缺糧缺水。

items.t: 北京讚揚香港選委會選舉投票踴躍
items.d: 數以千計選民投票選出負責選舉特首的選舉委員會，北京稱選舉競爭良性。

items.t: Nvidia一日市值增近一萬億美元
items.d: 這是該公司二十多年來最好的一日，收復黃仁勳離任後大部分跌幅；美國證監會及司法部調查仍在進行。

items.t: 德勤預測香港財政重回盈餘
items.d: 德勤估計2026/27年度盈餘208億港元，財政儲備於2027年3月底升至約6,863億港元。

items.t: Dell及HPE擬加AI伺服器價最多45%
items.d: 即使合約已簽，客戶仍被要求付更多，反映AI需求推高記憶體及晶片成本。

items.t: Nvidia十一日後重新委任黃仁勳為行政總裁
items.d: 董事會稱與他及美國官員商討後滿意，認為沒有國家安全風險。他早前因婚外情辭職，其中一人涉嫌是中國間諜。

items.t: Apple為Mac研發自主AI代理
items.d: 該代理可自行跨應用程式完成工作，令Apple與OpenAI及Anthropic直接競爭。

items.t: AI排放急增 Meta重新檢討2030淨零目標
items.d: 耗電的AI數據中心令其排放一年內增約四成，至逾2,170萬公噸。

items.t: 數學家稱Claude協助證明黎曼猜想
items.d: Anthropic的Levent Alpoge發表可由電腦驗證的證明；專家仍在核實它是否真正解決這個167年難題。

items.t: Chrome修補六個嚴重漏洞 其中兩個由AI發現
items.d: Google呼籲用戶立即更新；顯示AI工具愈來愈多被用來找出嚴重保安漏洞。

items.t: 供應鏈攻擊令大型新聞網站播出惡意程式碼
items.d: 黑客入侵CNN、BBC及Zoom等網站使用的Optimizely軟件，短暫向訪客推送有害程式。

items.t: 美國失去消除麻疹地位 為25年來首次
items.d: 泛美衛生組織確認，美國今年麻疹個案逾5,400宗；調查顯示疫苗謬誤仍然普遍。

items.t: 新發現病毒揭示演化缺失一環
items.d: 科學家利用AI蛋白質工具找到微小病毒，顯示病毒與細胞內稱為encapsulin的結構曾多次互相演化而來。

items.t: 以Jim Lovell命名貨運飛船將飛往太空站
items.d: Northrop Grumman的Cygnus XL將由SpaceX獵鷹9號運載約5噸物資，最早11月29日發射。

items.t: 賓咸向議員力撐與歐盟的「里程碑」協議
items.d: 首相稱協議代表改變而非破舊現狀，但表示不經公投重新加入歐盟是不可想像的。

items.t: 天氣持續寒冷不穩 氣象局發降雪警告
items.d: 英國氣象局警告生效，有降雪及結冰風險，出門前宜查看交通情況。
